interface.title: GeoDFN – Geologically Consistent Discrete Fracture Network Generator
interface.field: Structural geology / fractured-reservoir and subsurface flow modelling
interface.stage_of_work: Model building: turning outcrop fracture statistics into stochastic 2D fracture networks for use in flow and transport simulators
interface.what_it_is_for: Generate ensembles of 2D discrete fracture networks from per-set length, spacing, orientation, intensity and stress-shadow buffer statistics, choose an aperture model, inspect per-realization statistics and export everything as a ZIP.

data.note: All inputs came from built-in presets (Brazil Apodi, Single Set, Orthogonal set, Conjugate set) or were typed in by hand for an extra fracture set. The app opened on 'Custom' with empty fields, not on Brazil Apodi as the code notes said. Nothing was uploaded.

features.name: Preset scenario loader that fills a multi-section parameter form
features.general: Pick a named template from a dropdown so that every downstream input fills with calibrated defaults, then adjust from there
features.specific: The Preset dropdown (Custom / Brazil Apodi / Single Set / Orthogonal set / Conjugate set) sets the domain size, number of sets, aperture method and every per-set distribution and parameter
steps: Check the domain, set count and aperture method it filled in
Open the set tabs to review or edit the values it loaded
serves_tasks: Switch to a different template scenario
Test how changing one input parameter alters the generated network

features.name: Per-group tabbed distribution editor with distribution-dependent parameter fields
features.general: For each group of items, choose a statistical distribution for each property from a dropdown; the parameter inputs change to match the distribution chosen; the number of tabs follows a count control
features.specific: The Fracture Sets tabs (Set 1…N, driven by 'Number of Fracture sets'). Each holds Intensity, Buffer zone method (Constant m / Linear × length) and three columns: Fracture Length (Log-Normal μσ, Power-law α, Constant L, Exponential λ, each with Lmin/Lmax), Spatial Distribution (Log-Normal, Power-law α + min dist, Uniform) and Orientation (Von-Mises mean/κ/θmin/θmax, Uniform θmin/θmax, Constant θ)
steps: Set the number of groups with the +/- stepper
Pick a distribution for length, spacing and orientation
Pick the buffer method and its value
serves_tasks: Adjust the statistics of one fracture family
Add a new fracture family and enter its statistics by hand
Test how changing one input parameter alters the generated network

features.name: Physical-model selector with model-specific parameter panel
features.general: Choose one of several constitutive models from a dropdown, fill in that model's own parameters, and see the effect in a summary metric after running
features.specific: Fracture Aperture Method: constant (Aperture), subLinear (Scaling coeff., Scaling exp.), Barton-Bandis (JRC, JCS, σ_Hmax, σ_c, Strike), Lepillier (initial aperture, S_Hmax, S_hmin, E, ν, Strike). The result appears as 'Mean aperture (m)' in Statistics
serves_tasks: Choose a physical model for fracture opening
Read summary statistics for each realization and the number of fractures in each set

features.name: Ensemble run with validation, progress and stop
features.general: Start a batch of N stochastic simulations; inputs are checked first, a progress bar counts finished members, and a run that stalls can be stopped
features.specific: Generate DFN checks parameters (e.g. 'Invalid parameters: Set 2: I must be a positive number'), shows 'Realization k of N complete…' and then '<N> realization(s) generated successfully'. Header Stop cancels a stalled run
steps: Read any validation error and fix the input
serves_tasks: Stop a run that does not finish
Set ensemble size and run label

features.name: Per-realization result tabs with metric cards and per-group counts
features.general: Browse the members of an ensemble in tabs; each tab shows headline metrics and a colour-keyed count of items per group, so members can be compared side by side
features.specific: Realization 1…N tabs, each with Statistics: Total fractures, Total intensity, Mean length, Max length, Mean aperture, and 'Per set' fracture counts with colour swatches. Each tab also has slots for a fracture map and a rose/stereonet image, but these only showed broken placeholders in this run, so the figures are not part of this feature as observed
serves_tasks: Read summary statistics for each realization and the number of fractures in each set
Test how changing one input parameter alters the generated network

features.name: Bundle export of the whole run
features.general: Package every output of the current run into one archive for use in another tool
features.specific: '⬇ Download Results (ZIP)' under Results downloads a ZIP of the generated ensemble (coordinates, apertures, stats, images according to the README; the contents were not verified)
steps: Optionally set Run name / Output folder
serves_tasks: Download the generated ensemble for an external simulator
